packages.title: BPR1S Key Mapper

manifest.title: BPR1S Key Mapper
manifest.appDescription: Maps the unused Home, OK, Back and Menu keys of the Boxput BPR1S Plus 2.4 GHz remote on rooted LG webOS TVs. Runs as a root service at boot; all other keys pass through unchanged.

packages.shortDescription: Root-only key mapper for the Boxput BPR1S Plus 2.4 GHz USB remote on LG webOS TVs. Home and Menu open the launcher, OK sends ENTER, Back sends ESC; all other keys pass through unchanged. Idles at 0 percent CPU and autostarts at boot.
packages.description: Root-only background service for LG webOS TVs. Maps the keys webOS ignores on the Boxput BPR1S Plus 2.4 GHz USB remote: Home and Menu open the launcher, OK sends ENTER, Back sends ESC. All other keys pass through unchanged. The daemon never grabs the dongle and filters out its pointer/gyro interface, so it stays idle at 0 percent CPU. Autostarts via the Homebrew Channel init.d hook and is fully removed on uninstall. [Source](https://github.com/neoscaler/webos-bpr1s-keymapper)
